name: Oomiya Rikako
source:
A slutty female department head who unites the top departments in the company.

She is ready for battle 24 hours a day. The protagonist is her subordinate.

Everything she does is 10 times faster than normal people. It is unknown when she sleeps.

Nobody knows her "true self" if it even exists.

Her husband is also elite and an executive of another company, but there are rumors that they are separated.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=719516]getchu[/url]]
